name: hauberk
_deep_note: Returns deep (deep_bell) in the deep metals: the mithril shirt first, then glassteel, starmetal and adamantine. Brandon's defence-model decision 20 (2026-11-17): a Dexterity hero finds light and medium armour all the way down; it keeps the template's lower AC (the trade for the dodge and the speed).
lore_template: Every ring of this short {material_name} shirt is linked through four others and riveted shut. It rattles at each step, yet a sword edge that would have ended its wearer's days will slide away instead.
forms_note: Rings stop a cut but part under a point: a spear or a bodkin arrow finds the gaps.
